name: QK-Norm
tagline: Apply RMSNorm independently to per-head queries and keys before the scaled dot-product attention; positional info still comes from learned absolute embeddings.
diff_from_baseline: Henry et al., "Query-Key Normalization for Transformers" (EMNLP Findings 2020). Inspired by modded-nanogpt record #5. RMSNorm-ing Q and K separately before softmax bounds attention logits, stabilizing pretraining at higher learning rates without changing positional handling.

name: RoPE
tagline: Replace learned absolute position embeddings with rotary position embeddings applied to per-head Q and K via paired-half (split-then-rotate) rotation.
formula: $$\theta_i = 10000^{-2i/d_h},\;\; \mathrm{RoPE}(x, t)_{[:d/2]} = x_{1}\cos(t\theta) - x_{2}\sin(t\theta),\;\; _{[d/2:]} = x_{1}\sin(t\theta) + x_{2}\cos(t\theta);\;\; A = \mathrm{softmax}\!\big(\mathrm{RoPE}(Q)\,\mathrm{RoPE}(K)^\top / \sqrt{d_h}\big)V$$
diff_from_baseline: Su et al., RoFormer (Neurocomputing 2024 / arXiv 2021); inspired by modded-nanogpt record #2. Encodes positions through complex-plane rotations so that q·k depends only on relative positions; learned wpe is dropped from the GPT forward.

name: RoPE + QK-Norm
tagline: Combines rotary position embeddings with RMSNorm of Q and K (norm before rotation), matching the strongest modded-nanogpt attention recipe.
diff_from_baseline: Combination of Su et al. RoFormer + Henry et al. QK-Norm (modded-nanogpt records #2 + #5). Applies RMSNorm to Q and K and then rotates them with RoPE, jointly improving stability and relative-position handling. Strongest fixed-recipe attention baseline at this scale.
